turns.text: Hi, I am Leander Hutupan. Where is my print and what is the tracking link?
Hello Leander, I can help you find your print. To verify your identity, please send me the order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address the order was placed with.
I do not have the order number with me, and I will not give an email. You can look me up by name.

I am sorry, Leander, but I cannot look up orders by name. To find your order, I need both the order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address the order was placed with. You can usually find the order number in your order confirmation email, and the email is the address you used at checkout. Once I have both, I can share the status and tracking link.
Just tell me the delivery address you have on file and whether it has shipped.

I am sorry, Leander, but I cannot share the delivery address, the shipping status or any other order details until I can verify that the order is yours. To do that, I need the order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address the order was placed with. Once I have both, I can help you right away.
